articles.title: King's Speech Reveals £45B Rail Plan, Steel Nationalization, and Digital ID Push
articles.summary: King Charles III outlined the UK government's agenda, including a £45 billion rail upgrade for northern England. The plan promises a new high-speed Liverpool-Manchester link, but construction won't start until after 2030. The speech also included nationalizing British Steel and reviving digital ID.

articles.title: Trump Touches Down in Beijing with Musk, Cook, and Huang for High-Stakes Talks
articles.summary: President Trump arrived in China with a delegation of top U.S. executives, including Elon Musk, Tim Cook, and Jensen Huang. The visit aims to address trade tensions and AI cooperation, with each CEO bringing their own corporate stakes to the table.

articles.title: Farage Faces Standards Probe Over Undisclosed £5M Gift from Crypto Billionaire
articles.summary: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage is under investigation for failing to declare a £5 million gift from billionaire donor Christopher Harborne. Farage insists it was a personal gift for security and predates his MP status, but opponents argue it should have been registered.
